77258a9c78fff224.title: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
77258a9c78fff224.crux: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception. In this report, we present WeVisOne-VL (WeChat Vision All-in-One), a powerful VLM that unifies object-level and pixel-level perception through structured next-token prediction.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception.
📊 **Key Results:** Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception.
🚀 **Paradigm Shift:** Across over 30 benchmarks, WeVisOne-VL demonstrates leading performance on both object-level and pixel-level tasks, while maintaining robust rejection for object-absent queries.

b1d9c086198c27b5.title: Making MLLM Latents Matter: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning for Cinematic Video Generation
b1d9c086198c27b5.crux: Cinematic video generation requires both temporal inference from limited inputs (i.e., sparse rather than frame-by-frame guidance) and factor-aware control of character, scene, action, and camera. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer useful priors for both capabilities, but their representations are not automatically actionable for video generation: a Video Diffusion Transformer (DiT) may bypass them through native conditioning pathways, and using them does not ensure either factor-aware control or generation-compatible temporal prediction.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer useful priors for both capabilities, but their representations are not automatically actionable for video generation: a Video Diffusion Transformer (DiT) may bypass them through native conditioning pathways, and using them does not ensure either factor-aware control or generation-compatible temporal prediction.

📊 **Key Results:** Third, for temporal inference, text-only and text-plus-complete-video observations share a video target, and the trained DiT is then frozen while the MLLM and connector are optimized through it.

🚀 **Paradigm Shift:** Extensive experiments demonstrate our consistently better performance on three cinematic video generation tasks (i.e., sparse-to-video, factor-aware editing, and multi-shot generation) over baselines and validate FAPL's contributions to MLLM feature use, temporal control, and factor coordination.

b201c0c9f17296b1.title: Deep Search in Real-World Web Environments
b201c0c9f17296b1.crux: Despite substantial progress in Deep Search agents, their ability to conduct end-to-end research in real-world open Web environments remains insufficiently evaluated. Unlike static retrieval settings, information on the real-world Web is distributed across diverse sources, modalities, and heterogeneous formats, often involving complex interaction mechanisms that require agents to autonomously search for, access, and integrate relevant evidence during execution.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** To address this gap, we introduce the OpenDS task, designed to evaluate agents' ability to perform multi-step deep search in the live, open Web.
📊 **Key Results:** Despite substantial progress in Deep Search agents, their ability to conduct end-to-end research in real-world open Web environments remains insufficiently evaluated.
🚀 **Why It Matters:** OpenDS-World provides a unified evaluation platform for systematically assessing and advancing agents' autonomous deep search capabilities in real-world open Web environments.

b446be600a5953d5.title: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
b446be600a5953d5.crux: We present IQuest-Q1, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated). IQuest-Q1 is developed through a three-stage process: (1) stable and efficient pre-training, combining Stable SplitNorm, Muon, and muP with a two-stage curriculum whose second stage increases the coding-data mixture, preserving a wide stability margin between safe and optimal learning rates; (2) fine-grained mid-training, expanding the data mixture across domains and formats and progressively extending the context; and (3) multi-scaffold with multi-version post-training, combining SFT, domain-specialized RL, and MOPD across various scaffolds to integrate complementary training signals and strengthen agentic coding capabilities.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** We present IQuest-Q1, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated).
📊 **Key Results:** We present IQuest-Q1, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated).
🚀 **Paradigm Shift:** The resulting IQuest-Q1 demonstrates capabilities in both coding and general tasks.

069bf060f46882c9.title: HiSTEVE 1.0: Harnessing Human-Interface VLA Agents for Open-World Games
069bf060f46882c9.crux: Building virtual embodied agents that operate in open-ended games like human players is a long-standing goal requiring both long-horizon autonomy and reliable native-interface control. As a procedurally generated open world, Minecraft provides a natural testbed for studying the integration of these capabilities.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** To bridge this gap, we propose HiSTEVE, a hierarchical VLA agent with a capability-aware agent harness.
📊 **Key Results:** Existing agents typically provide either native visuomotor control without long-horizon autonomy or high-level planning executed through environment APIs or predefined skills.

🚀 **Why It Matters:** HiSTEVE achieves state-of-the-art atomic-task performance, scoring 85.0% on MineStudio Bench and a 37.4% average success rate on OpenHA, while also completing long-horizon tasks such as crafting an iron pickaxe from scratch like human players.

512b5f16450dea3b.title: RynnUnify: Towards Unified Embodied Brain
512b5f16450dea3b.crux: We introduce RynnUnify, a 16B unified embodied model that combines strong embodied understanding with long-horizon visual planning through interleaved video--language reasoning. With capabilities spanning spatial reasoning, physical prediction, and grounding, RynnUnify connects an understanding of the physical world with visual anticipation of how it evolves across successive subtasks.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** We introduce RynnUnify, a 16B unified embodied model that combines strong embodied understanding with long-horizon visual planning through interleaved video--language reasoning.

📊 **Key Results:** Building on these capabilities, we further develop an agentic extension through reinforcement learning to selectively use video predictions for reasoning about unobserved states and interaction outcomes.
🚀 **Why It Matters:** Together, these results establish RynnUnify as a shared foundation for embodied understanding, visual planning, and robot control, taking a step toward a unified embodied brain.

c8eb05f8bf1ef359.title: AV-FABLE: Audio-Visual Manipulation Forensics in Long-Form Videos
c8eb05f8bf1ef359.crux: Localized AI manipulations in long-form videos often affect brief events within otherwise authentic content, making video-level classification insufficient for forensic analysis. Existing audio-visual deepfake benchmarks largely focus on short talking-head clips, while long-form temporal forensics remains predominantly visual.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** We introduce AV-FABLE, a dual-timeline benchmark for sparse manipulations in open-scene long-form audio-visual videos.
📊 **Key Results:** Existing audio-visual deepfake benchmarks largely focus on short talking-head clips, while long-form temporal forensics remains predominantly visual.

🚀 **Paradigm Shift:** AV-FABLE contains 16,650 pristine--manipulated twin pairs (998 hours) created with 27 editing configurations, with separate audio and visual timelines that enable modality-specific temporal localization and expose errors hidden by joint-timeline evaluation.

cb1628196cfcce93.title: Representation Redistribution in Sparse Autoencoders
cb1628196cfcce93.crux: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose language model activations into sparse features, but prompt transformations designed to preserve the underlying request can redistribute activity across them. A feature change observed on one transformed prompt need not recur, and even a recurring change need not affect a downstream computation.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose language model activations into sparse features, but prompt transformations designed to preserve the underlying request can redistribute activity across them.

📊 **Key Results:** We introduce the redistribution sensitivity score (RSS), which identifies large feature responses that recur in a consistent direction, and evaluate the resulting supports on variants excluded from selection.

🚀 **Why It Matters:** RSS therefore provides a way to identify recurring sparse representation changes and quantify their contribution to a downstream readout without equating representation change with failure.

44e8988712f04bd2.title: ChronoReplay: One Answer Interface Is Not Enough for Streaming Spatial Intelligence
44e8988712f04bd2.crux: Training a spatial VLM to answer which side an object lies on does not require it to preserve the metric displacement that determines that answer, while supervision for a distance estimate may leave categorical relations largely unconstrained. When post-training emphasizes one readout, improvements can therefore concentrate on that interface while transfer to others remains weak or even degrades; we call this observed specialization interface lock-in.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** Adaptive frame selection then changes evidence access while keeping the trained model fixed, providing an additional inference-time gain at lower visual cost.

📊 **Key Results:** Under the same observation access, a single ChronoReplay checkpoint improves OVO-S-Bench, OST-Bench, and UCS-Bench together, including a 13.41-point gain on OST-Bench, and achieves the highest three-benchmark mean among the supervision settings compared here.

🚀 **Paradigm Shift:** Same-data controls further separate the ingredients of this transfer: answer serialization redistributes gains across OST and UCS, family-balanced learning improves over ordinary joint SFT and natural turn weighting, and chronological replay exceeds a shifted-order control by about 2.41 OST points across two paired seeds.

a77e7c867afad54f.title: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs

key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** Interactive world models generate visual content conditioned on user actions, yet maintaining spatial consistency over long-horizon exploration in real time remains challenging.
📊 **Key Results:** Interactive world models generate visual content conditioned on user actions, yet maintaining spatial consistency over long-horizon exploration in real time remains challenging.

🚀 **Why It Matters:** Experiments show that L3G-World achieves state-of-the-art generation quality and long-horizon spatial consistency, with up to 38.6times fewer 3D primitives, 3.2times faster memory updates, and 359times faster memory rendering relative to the most efficient prior 3D-memory baseline for each metric, enabling real-time world generation at 9 FPS.

28cdd95941dc23f5.crux: For a decade, progress in artificial intelligence has been measured by how much a machine can do on its own. Large foundation models now write code and run multistep tasks, and personal agents act on a person's behalf.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** Large foundation models now write code and run multistep tasks, and personal agents act on a person's behalf.

📊 **Key Results:** Realizing it calls for a new kind of system, a cognitive symbiont: a lifelong, embedded, real-time, private, low-friction, and proactive companion that senses what the person senses through external devices, keeps their context across years, models their situation and their mind, takes part in their thinking at the right moment, carries out everyday tasks with their context, and keeps learning the person as both change.

🚀 **Paradigm Shift:** Alongside artificial general intelligence, which asks how intelligent a machine can be, stands AI-augmented human intelligence (AHI), which asks how much intelligence a machine can enable in a particular person.

4e31ed263a0d5f16.title: SplatAnything: Gaussian Spacing Normalization for Feed-forward 3DGS across Arbitrary Scenes
4e31ed263a0d5f16.crux: We identify a key limitation of existing feed-forward 3DGS methods: Gaussian attributes are typically predicted in a radial-distance-normalized space that canonicalizes a global radial statistic of the reconstructed geometry, while the spacing between neighboring Gaussian centers can still vary substantially across scene scales and camera configurations. This mismatch induces systematic shifts in Gaussian-scale targets, leading to ambiguous supervision.

cc49c5178495f576.title: P^2-MOPD: Accelerating Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Parameter Priors
cc49c5178495f576.crux: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation consolidates expert capabilities by supervising student-generated trajectories, whereas task arithmetic offers a training-free alternative through linear parameter combinations. We view the linear combination of student and expert parameters as a single differentiable model and propose P^2-MOPD, which jointly optimizes the mixing coefficients and the student weights under the same on-policy distillation objective.

🚀 **Why It Matters:** At the end of training, our 1.7B model reaches 94.7% average recovery, versus 80.9% for MOPD.

key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** In this work, we present Confucius4-R2T2 (short for Real Real-Time Transcription), a stable-prefix streaming ASR model that never modifies its earlier output while maintaining high accuracy and low latency.

c7d925246378dd35.title: PCBRouteAgent: How Close Are LLM Agents to Becoming PCB Routing Engineers?
c7d925246378dd35.crux: Automating printed circuit board (PCB) routing requires coordinating board-level connectivity decisions with geometric execution under strict design rules. Although recent agents can interact with native routing tools, reliable routing on complex boards remains challenging.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** We present PCBRouteAgent, a multimodal PCB routing agent inspired by how human engineers coordinate global strategy with local execution.
📊 **Key Results:** Automating printed circuit board (PCB) routing requires coordinating board-level connectivity decisions with geometric execution under strict design rules.
🚀 **Why It Matters:** On the three real-world subsets, PCBRouteAgent outperforms the best evaluated baseline in clean-pass rate by 13.9, 36, and 10 percentage points, respectively.

cd0ecea7d4995751.title: WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence
cd0ecea7d4995751.crux: Visual generative models increasingly blur the line between synthesizing observations and simulating environments. Yet visual plausibility alone does not constitute successful world modeling: compelling outputs may lack persistent state, physical dynamics, or causally consistent responses to interactions.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** Visual generative models increasingly blur the line between synthesizing observations and simulating environments.
📊 **Key Results:** We present WorldFoundry, open-source infrastructure for reproducible inference and evaluation across video, 3D and 4D, embodied action, and interactive world systems.

🚀 **Paradigm Shift:** WorldFoundry enables reproducible comparison of persistent, controllable dynamics across heterogeneous systems, advancing the field from perceptual synthesis toward measurable world intelligence.

1781547a3763a36b.title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
1781547a3763a36b.crux: We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. Through explicit monitoring and control, the system revises its understanding of evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions, then uses these assessments to adapt research targets and select reusable reasoning methods.
